Package com.example.eventlottery.domain

Class PolicyViolation

java.lang.Object
com.example.eventlottery.domain.PolicyViolation
public class PolicyViolation extends Object
Model for policy violation records Tracks comments deleted by admins for policy violations. Supports US 03.10.01 - Track and audit removed comments.
